source: Yell sã n maan n looge, a ka yit nebã sũyẽ ye.
target: Even if an event has passed, it remains engraved in the hearts.

source: Ned sen tar dɩtba, n yaool n ka tar tʋmtʋmdb ye.
target: This is the case of one who has eaters but not workers.

source: Bũmb fãa ratame tɩ b reng n segle.
target: Everything needs preparation.

source: Yel-paalg manegr yaa toogo.
target: A new problem is difficult to solve.

source: Ned sã n pa tar paoong tɩ seke, bɩ a gũus ne a goamã, ka rẽ a tõe n paama yãnde.
target: When one does not have enough wealth, one should be careful what one says. Otherwise it is a disgrace.

source: Tõd-beoog tõta zaabre.
target: In order to get up early, one prepares in the evening.

source: Yik pĩnd n são kẽn-tʋʋlse.
target: It is better to get up early than to walk in a hurry.

source: a) Ka Wakat fãa la ned tog n zãgs rɩɩb ye.
target: a) It is not at all times that one should refuse to eat.

source: Ned buud fãa sã n tʋmdẽ, a tẽeda yõodo.
target: Whoever works hopes for a profit.

source: B sã n maneg fo yelle, bɩ f ra yɩ zɩ-beoog soab ye, tɩ yell a to tõe n le waame.
target: If your problem is solved, do not be ungrateful, for another problem may arise again.

source: Ned nug sã n pa são, bɩ a bas sãan wa bãng a yiri.
target: If you can't afford it, you should avoid inviting strangers to your home.

source: Pa ki pĩnd sɩɩgr yaa toogo.
target: It is difficult to remove the skin from a type of animal that has never been seen dead.

source: Kolg tɩ d n ka wẽnd f ma sẽn moe ye.
target: Eating at someone's house who invited you is different from the way you do it when your mother cooked.

source: Katr ka wiid nag-wagr koom zaalem ye.
target: A hyena does not draw water for a sickly cow without an ulterior motive.

source: Fo sã n yet tɩ zug ka nemdo, bɩ f wẽbg f mengã zug n gese.
target: Let him who says that the head is not fleshy, feel his own to see.

source: Zĩig sã n sobg me, sor ka menem ye.
target: Even if the twilight comes, the road does not disappear.

source: Pag sã n wĩid a tão lamdo, n yaool n wãbd a sɩd bɛnga, a sɩdã n yã bõne.
target: When a woman spins her brother's cotton while eating her husband's beans, it means that her husband is a loser.

source: Zug sã n põnge, a ka pam ye.
target: If a head is shaved, it is not packed.

source: Wend na reeg more, yaa mo-wagre. b) Ned sã n zãgs saglgo a tõe n wa tudgame.
target: The Muslim who refuses the offer of food is a stunted Muslim. b) He who refuses advice may one day make a mistake.

source: Ra wɩd neb a taabã, tɩ b na n wɩda fo me.
target: Do not criticise others, for one day you will be criticised too.

source: F sã n paam yell bɩ f yals n bao a tɩɩm.
target: When a problem happens to you, take the trouble to try to solve it.

source: Yell sã n ya fo yell bɩ f ra baood n dat n gil-a ye.
target: When a problem concerns you, do not try to avoid it.

source: Ned yell sã n ya fo yelle, bɩ f togs-a sɩda.
target: When you are concerned about someone else's problem, tell them the truth.

source: Ned fãa gũus ne wilg-m-menga.
target: Let everyone beware of pride.

source: Ned sã n gãand zãmbɛɛl n tʋbs kolkoodo, na n lʋɩɩ a mengã yãoog zugu.
target: If someone lies on his back and spits, he receives the spit on his chest.

source: Maan tɩ b ges sɛta pãnga.
target: Arrogant work exhausts strength.

source: F maan wẽnga, f maana f menga ; f maan neere, f maana f menga.
target: If you do good, you do it to yourself, and if you do bad, you do it to yourself.

source: Rʋʋdem baasda a soab taoor bala.
target: Urine always ends in front of the one who emits it.

source: Maan f tʋʋmã neere, tɩ rẽ la f paamd yõodo.
target: Do your work well and you will profit.

source: Ra maan f toog ka be ne ned a to yell ye.
target: Do not be indifferent to the problems of others.

source: Maan tɩ d loog sɛta pãnga.
target: Too much extravagance drains one's strength.

source: Fo sã n paoog neda, fo paoogda f menga.
target: If you despise your neighbour, you despise yourself.

source: Ned sã n sõngd foom, bɩ fo me modgd n paasdẽ.
target: When someone helps you, make an effort.

source: Ra wa m yiri, yaa ra wa m yir a yiibu.
target: Don't come to my house is the same as twice don't come to my house.

source: Maan bala, koosda bala.
target: Poorly made goods sell poorly.

source: Fo sã n ka rat n zoe n bas neda, bɩ f ra n tĩig tɩɩm n bas-a ye.
target: If you do not wish to leave someone behind when you flee, do not take the remedy of speed alone.

source: Ned sã n sẽdg f poore, bɩ fo me widg f nenga.
target: While your back is being washed, wash your face as well.

source: Ra paoog kãsem tɩ nindaare, fo tõe n yɩɩ kãsma.
target: Do not despise the elder, for you may one day become an elder.

source: Rɩ-y n bas-y zõanga, yaa sẽn ka fo zõangã.
target: When you say of a blind man, "Eat without him," it means that he is not your relative.

source: Nug ka põogd tɩ b wãag n lob ye.
target: You don't cut off a hand and throw it away because it is rotten.

source: Yʋʋr sã n wãag f zugẽ bɩ f so a koom.
target: When a canary of water breaks over your head, wash yourself of the water.

source: Zood data zems taaba, la pʋ-peelem.
target: Friendship requires understanding and openness.

source: Rẽ wilgdame tɩ fo me ka naong soab ye.
target: At least it shows that you are not poor.

source: Fo sã n tar neba, bɩ f ra gom yaar ye.
target: When one has many people under one's responsibility, one does not speak anywhere or in any way.

source: Ra gil buudã yell ye.
target: Be concerned about the problems of your family.

source: Tʋʋm-bil n são zaalem.
target: A small job is better than nothing at all.

source: Baa f sã n tar noor me, tʋmdẽ ne sik-m-menga.
target: Even if you have authority, you must work with humility.

source: Ned sã n tar neb wʋsgo, bɩ a gũus ne tʋʋm-yaare.
target: When one is responsible for many people, one should be careful not to act in a disorderly manner.

source: B kɩsa sɩd ne taaba.
target: It means that there is some trust.

source: Fo roagdbã yell ka gind foo ye.
target: The problem of a close relative is also your problem.

source: Sõngr tʋʋmd ka be yaams ye, tɩ bõe, fo me yɩb n datame tɩ b sõng-fo.
target: Don't get tired of helping others, because sometimes you need help.

source: Be zʋʋr ka gãngd bugum ye.
target: He who has a tail does not step over fire.

source: Rog wʋsg ka kelemd wagdr ye, tɩ b tõe n wa mikame tɩ ya fo meng biiga.
target: He who has given birth to many children does not cry "thief", because it could be one of his children.

source: Zug koom ka gind neng ye.
target: The water that flows from the head cannot go around the face.

source: Nin-kẽem-yoog zɩ tɩ yãag bɩtame.
target: A foolish old man does not know that a child grows up.

source: Ne y kẽnd sãoo ne y zĩiga.
target: "Congratulations on your walk" is better than "congratulations on sitting".

source: Ki sã n ka raadẽ me, bɩ fo me ki peoog be raagẽ.
target: Even if millet does not sell well at the market, you should still take your millet basket to the market.

source: Buud warb sã n saood laag pʋgẽ bɩ fo me ning naoore.
target: When the family dance is performed in a step, try to put your foot in it too.

source: Rɩ-y n bas-y a zagla, yaa f sẽn mi a pʋgã.
target: If you say: "Eat without him", it means that you know the state of his stomach.

source: Ned fãa gũus n da pʋlem bũmb ning a sẽn ka tõe ye.
target: Let everyone beware of promising what he cannot give.

source: Neb sã n naag taab n maan bũmbu, b tog n yɩɩ noor a yembre.
target: When you do something together, you must do it by mutual agreement.

source: Sẽn paam-a bilfã baas n sãoo sẽn kong-a wã.
target: He who has had a little is better than he who has had none.

source: Reng-y n zems-y taab n yaool n kẽng naab nengẽ.
target: Agree first before you go to the chief.

source: Fo sã n paam bũmb n yãbd tɩ ka waooga, fo laada sẽn ka paam-a bũmbã.
target: If you lament about the little you got, you are mocking the one who got nothing.

source: Wilgdame tɩ fo ratame n sõng-a, yaa f ka tõeeme.
target: It shows that you want to help him, but only you cannot.

source: Fo sã n yeel tɩ fo yellã ka be to, yaa foo n ka soke.
target: If you say that your problem is unparalleled, it is because you have not asked about others.

source: Ned tog m maana gũusg ne bũmb nins a sẽn nongã.
target: Everyone should be careful what they like.

source: Yaa sẽn na n wilg tɩ f be a poorẽ toog la noog pʋgẽ.
target: It shows that you share his joys and sorrows.

source: Nebã sã n sak taaba, b tõe n saka naaba.
target: Those who are obedient to each other will also be obedient to the chief.

source: Fo sã n yeel tɩ wudg zẽem noom ne voaag zẽedo, fo na n yõoga f lurga.
target: If you say that millet husk potash makes kapok flower sauce good, you will set fire to your granary.

source: Wagda sã n yi taaba, naab na n yõg-b lame.
target: When thieves disagree, the chief will eventually get his hands on them.

source: Bugurn dɩ maam, f laada yɩgre.
target: When you say 'fire consumes me', you are making fun of the home.

source: Pa tɩg m saamba, fo laada a yõadɩ.
target: To say that one has not enjoyed one's father enough is to mock the one who was born after the death of his father.

source: Pa tɩg gõeem yʋngẽ, fo laada kũum.
target: To say that one did not sleep enough last night is to mock the dead.

source: Koaas sã n yeel tɩ yẽ koosa bʋʋg n lʋɩ, bʋʋgã me ka yik ye.
target: If the butcher says that when he sold the meat of his goat he made a loss, the goat also did not rise.

source: Fo sõm soab sã n zɩt tãnga, bɩ f viib tʋʋsg n yɛgda.
target: When your benefactor carries a mountain on his head, be willing to help him.

source: Yãag m dɛɛm tɩ wobdo, yaa tɩ wags taab ne zoeese.
target: To go with your father-in-law because of the fear of elephants is to compete with him in the race.

source: M ka na n kãab m dɛɛmb gɛl la m ka lob m toor ye.
target: I will not promise eggs to my father-in-law as if I were laying them myself.

source: Bilf n são zaalem.
target: A little is better than nothing.

source: Takem-takem são no-vɩʋʋgo.
target: Stirring the little that goes into your mouth is better than an empty mouth.

source: Ned sẽn maan bũmb ningã la a le reegda.
target: You reap what you sow.

source: Sẽn tʋmd-a n são sẽn ka rat-a n maan bũmbã.
target: He who works is better than he who does not want to do anything.

source: Reeg la f gãand n são loog n gãande.
target: "Have some food and go to sleep" is better than "go to bed".

source: Zoe-bõn soab ka rat tɩ ned rɩ a bũmb ye.
target: The miser does not want anyone to taste what is his.

source: Fo sã n ka zĩnd yell sɩngrẽ, bɩ f gũus ne a goama.
target: If you have not witnessed a matter at its beginning, beware of speaking about it.

source: Fo sã n bas sɩd n gom zirẽ, f paamda yelle.
target: If instead of telling the truth you start lying, you will get into trouble.

source: Zems-taab n são arzɛka.
target: Agreement is better than wealth.

source: Maag-m-meng n tɩgd yell võore.
target: It is the one who uses patience who comes to understand things well.

source: Tar n gomd são ro-vɩʋʋgo.
target: Having someone next to you to talk to is better than an empty hut.

source: Sũ-noog ka kẽed ned ne lingr ye.
target: Joy does not enter a person by surprise.

source: Nug sã n bas a soaba, bɩ gõos yor-a.
target: When the hand moves away from the body, it will be scratched by thorns.

source: Maan tɩ b tar n gomd sãoo fo n ka yelle.
target: To act and to be criticized is better than to be said to be blameless.

source: Kom zak sãoo zabr zaka.
target: A house without bread is better than a house full of quarrels.

source: Wil-wil gɛla zãagr bõne.
target: Teal eggs: we will all lose.

source: Neb a yiib sã n zabd taab pisi poorẽ, ned a ye n dat piig la a nu.
target: If two men fight over the division of 100 francs, it is because one of them wants 75 francs.

source: Busl yet t'a ka yãgd ne a gãag soab ye.
target: The fly larva says that it is not impatient for the arrival of its host.

source: Biig ka yã a ma wẽndẽ n yet t'a ba kẽ ne wɩɩbdo.
target: The child who did not see his mother when she was young says that his father married an ugly woman.

source: Ned sã n sɩng tʋʋmd tɩ kũum wa, fãa sɛɛme.
target: If someone undertakes to do something and dies, it is all over.

source: Ned yam ka yɩɩd a sagend ye.
target: One is not smarter than his adviser.

source: F sã n ka na n maneg yell me, bɩ f ra sãam ye.
target: If you don't want to go to great lengths to fix it, don't spoil it either.

source: Bʋʋg ka rʋʋd ne-guug t'a biig pa tẽng ye.
target: If the goat climbs the mill, its kid does not stay on the ground.

source: Ned ziir ka yɩɩd a ba ye.
target: The child has no more glory than his father.

source: Walg ka zoet t'a biig keoos ye.
target: When the doe runs, her cub does not stay behind.

source: Tɩ ba wã ne biigã fãa bõosdame, la ma wã n so rɩɩbã n pʋɩta.
target: The father and the child ask for food to be brought to them, but here the mother is in charge of sharing the food.

source: Sugr n são bʋʋm.
target: To forgive is worth more than being right.

source: Tʋʋm-sõng ka tog n tũus n tʋm ye.
target: As long as a job is good, do it.

source: Yell fãa bee Wẽnnaam nugẽ.
target: All things depend on God.

source: Ned woglem ka yɩɩd a geoof ye.
target: No one is taller than the tip of his hair.

source: Gombg sã n kõgd a rã-yũug tɩ weoog yõk bugum, Wẽnd na taas-d vẽer saame.
target: If the praying mantis is preparing his beer for the ritual feast, and a bush fire breaks out, it is no longer the time to wish each other a good feast.

source: Katr sã n yõk tẽng tãmpĩir bɩ b rig n deeg tɩ sã n ka rẽ, a tõe n wa yõka na-biig beoogo.
target: If a hyena catches a bastard, let the village catch him to get him back, because tomorrow it might be a prince's turn.

source: Biig ka rɩt ne a ma n yãgd wa a rɩta ne a ba ye.
target: The child who eats with his mother does not hurry as if he was eating with his father.

source: Tẽng-n-ned sa n zab ne a to n kong bʋʋm, yaa t’a yĩma yellã.
target: If someone in the village quarrels with another member of the village without finding a reason, it is because he has forgotten what happened.

source: Bugum sã n yõk zug bɩ yõor ra la ye.
target: If the head catches fire, the nose should not mock it.

source: Ned sã n mak n na n maneg n ka tõog n são sẽn tõog n sãam-a.
target: He who tries unsuccessfully to arrange is better than he who tries successfully to spoil.

source: Wẽnd ka kʋ, naab ka kʋʋd ye.
target: If God does not kill, the ruler cannot ki

source: Bi-bɩɩg togame n tar saag-sõama.
target: A young man should rather have good ambitions.

source: Fo sã n tar pãnga, tẽeg tu pãn-saar me n be.
target: If you are strong now, remember that there will be a time when that strength will end.

source: Zug koom ka gind neng ye.
target: Water poured on the head cannot go around the face.

source: Fo sẽn teeg ned ningã sã n paam yelle, fo me ka na n põs ye.
target: If the person on whom your hope rests is in trouble, you cannot be spared.

source: Neb sã n namsd-fo, bas n kõ Wẽnde.
target: If people mistreat you, trust in God.

source: Yel-bil yell la b tõe n tar n gomda.
target: It is when a matter is still small that one can talk about it.

source: Fo sã n maan yell n paam sugri, bɩ f modg n da paas a to ye.
target: When you are forgiven for a certain fault, make an effort not to commit another one.

source: Baag sã n ki, bɩ ãbs ra maan sũ-noog ye.
target: When the dog dies, let not its fleas rejoice.

source: Fo sã n pẽgd f ma warba, fo ka sa kʋ-rot ye.
target: If you are positive about your mother's dance, you have not been to any house with a funeral.

source: Wẽnd kũun yɩɩd baoobo.
target: God's gift is more than personal effort.

source: Fo sã n kẽnd kiu-kiu, bɩ f tẽeg lama-lama yelle.
target: If you walk with your foot tapping, remember that there will be muffled steps.

source: Wed-moaag yet tɩ yẽ ka noor n pʋʋsd sãy ye.
target: The horse says he does not know how to thank the blacksmith.

source: Wẽ-bil n be yãbre.
target: It is after a small blow that one can cry.

source: Ki na faag ka bi-bɩɩg goam ye, fo na n dɩɩ bõe n bɩ ?
target: It is not for the young man to say that millet will not produce, otherwise what will he eat to grow?

source: Naam ne sutg sãoo talemd ne peoogo.
target: A ladle measure of power is better than a basket of subject quality.

source: Wẽnd na yiis yõngr lɩngẽ, la yõngr me ra le kẽ ye.
target: May God bring the mouse out of the gourd, but may the mouse beware of falling back into it

source: Sãan sã n wa sig fap yʋngo, bãng t;a rat n gãandame.
target: If a stranger comes to your house at night, know that he wants to spend the night.

source: Fo ka tog n yag zĩrẽ neb sẽn mi foo sʋk ye.
target: One should not lie in an environment where one is known.

source: Sagenda tʋmtʋmd t’a maneg n tʋm sõma t'a gɛtbã yaa wʋsgo.
target: Let him who does his work do it well, for there are eyewitnesses.

source: Zãag ne wẽnga.
target: It is better to stay away from evil.

source: F sã n sɩng bũmbu, bɩ f modg n baase.
target: When you start something, you must finish it.

source: B tog n kõo sẽn beeg-a zu-noogo.
target: The offender must be given a second chance.

source: Bas-taal soab n tɩgd dɩɩbo.
target: Only the tolerant man eats to his fill.

source: Kõn deeg saglg baasda wẽng pʋga.
target: The man who rejects advice will end up badly.

source: Yel-wẽn-maand zoeta yelle.
target: The wrongdoer is afraid of getting into trouble.

source: Baag ka kʋʋd a wɩɩb-yɛng ye.
target: The dog is not killed at its first fault.

source: Nin-kʋʋd zoet guugu.
target: The executioner is afraid of the club.

source: Zõang korg sẽn sẽt neerã, yaa ninã rãmb yĩnga.
target: If a nice bag is made for the blind man, it is for the sighted who look at it.

source: Kom sã n kʋ tẽng-n-biiga, yaa yel-bi n kʋ-a.
target: If hunger kills a native, it is in fact small mischief that has killed him.

source: Yeel-kõn-deeg nintãm yẽesda ne rũmdi.
target: He who rejects advice will wipe his tears with his knee.

source: Wa bãng m zĩiga, ka wũumdid sũng pʋg ye.
target: The game of hide-and-seek is not played in a field of earthen pitch.

source: Bas m nugu, sõng tɩ b ra gãd ye.
target: Instead of saying: "Let go of my hand", avoid being caught.

source: F sã n sak pidbu, bɩ f sak taeebo.
target: If you agree to have a rope put around your neck, agree to be pulled with it.

source: Pag ka yi kuilb n wa zaabr ye.
target: If a woman comes to visit you in the evening, it is not to return home soon.

source: Ninsaal ka tõe n bãng beoog yell ye.
target: Nobody can know what will happen tomorrow.

source: Ninsaal ka tõe n põs yel-lingdg ye.
target: The man cannot avoid what happens to him by surprise.

source: Ra tags tɩ f yaa tɩrga, tɩ f tʋʋmã yaool n ka tɩrs ye.
target: Do not think that you are righteous, while your actions are not righteous.

source: Ned fãa maan sugr tɩ rũndã loogdame n beoog watẽ.
target: Everyone should calm down, today passes and tomorrow comes.

source: Ned fãa gũus ne a yel-manesem.
target: Everyone should be careful with his behaviour.

source: Ka tog n gomd ned taoor t'a ka na n yɩ neer ye.
target: One should not make negative predictions about a person in his presence.

source: Gũus f meng ne yam a yiib soaba.
target: Beware of the man with two faces.

source: Reng n sagl f meng n yaool n sagl f to.
target: Advise yourself before you advise others.

source: Yaa beoog gomd leokr yĩnga.
target: It is to answer another day.

source: Fo sã n ka na n tʋm yoogo, bɩ f ra yeel f to t'a tʋm yoog ye.
target: If you do not want to do harm, do not ask others to do it.

source: Wẽnd na gu-d ne liuul kõn-fʋrg-lalle, wĩntoogo a tũuda liuuli, yʋngo a gãee ne laoose.
target: God forbid the bird with two faces: by day he is with the birds, but by night he spends time with the rats.

source: Wed-kũum ka gomd wed-doogẽ ye.
target: The death of horses does not speak in the stable.

source: Noaag ka kongd koom daar a ye n wãag no-sar ye.
target: The hen should not break the trough for not finding water there this day.

source: Pa wã n yeendã, sã n pa yɩ-f noogo, rẽnd yɩ-f-la toogo.
target: When one avoids talking about something, it is because one has a good or bad memory of it.

source: Bãngẽ yaa pag bi-yaooga.
target: "If I knew" is said when my wife gives birth to her last child.

source: Bõang sã n na n lub-fu, f ka yãt a tʋb ye.
target: When the donkey is going to knock you down, you can't see his ears.

source: Ra yet tɩ f ma yaa rʋmde, t’a yaool n moend baas ye.
target: Do not say that your mother is the favourite of your father's wives, if it is known that she prepares for the dogs.

source: F sã n ka na n ning la-wɛdgẽ n dɩ, bɩ f ra ning n kõ-f to ye.
target: If you do not want to eat from a broken dish, do not serve your neighbour from a broken dish.

source: Reng n yagl f meng n yaool n yagl kapidgu.
target: Place yourself (on the branch) before placing the hive.

source: Pondr ka yõgd pag ye, la a rõabg pag taoorã ka zems ye.
target: Even though the toad is not courting a woman, his position in front of her is suspicious.

source: Saglg sẽn kengd sũuri.
target: This is a piece of advice for encouragement.

source: a) Ned ka tõe n kõ n yɩɩg a tarem ye.
target: a) One cannot give beyond one's means.

source: Ninsaal fãa pãng tara tɛka.
target: Every man has his limits.

source: A ka le soa a meng ye, a vɩɩ ne neda.
target: She is no longer free, she lives with someone.

source: Ned sã n pa nong neda, a ka pẽgd a bũmb ye.
target: When you don't like someone, you never appreciate what he has.

source: Gũus-m-meng n são ka zoet yelle.
target: Caution is better than stubbornness.

source: Bũmb fãa bee ne a sẽn tog ne.
target: Each thing has what it needs.

source: Zãag wẽng n be, tõog wẽng ka ye.
target: It is easier to stay away from evil than to try to overcome it.

source: Soaamb ka nobd n yɩɩg a gãong ye. b) Ned ka tõe n tʋm n yɩɩg a pãng ye.
target: The hare does not grow bigger than its skin allows. b) One cannot work beyond one's physical capacity.

source: Koom sã n zoe n tãag tãnga, a tãaga a tɛka.
target: When the flowing water meets a mountain, that is where its course ends.

source: Ned sã n pa nong neda, a kurg yaa yolgo.
target: When one does not like someone, one says that the trousers he is wearing are a bag.

source: Pa nong m woglem yet tɩ m yaa songlgo.
target: The one who doesn't like my big size says that I am long.

source: Pa nong m koeelem yet tɩ m yaa giurg wa lugri.
target: Whoever doesn't like me says I look like a doorpost.

source: Gʋʋr tog n yaa miuugu, t'a koaasdã ya zẽega.
target: The cola should be red, and its seller light in colour.

source: F sã n ka lub a Poko, bɩ f ra yet tɩ f na n luba a Raoog ye. Bilgífi : F sã n ka tõog yel-bíla, bɩ f ra bao yel-bed ye.
target: If you couldn't take down a woman, don't pretend you can take down a man. Meaning 1 If you couldn't solve a small problem, don't look for big problems.

source: Pa-kuil sã n kuil sɩda, bilim-yaar saame.
target: When a virgin gets married, no more uncontrolled rolling.

source: Rabɛɛm ka mi tɩ zabr tõe n vaalame ye.
target: The fearful man does not imagine that the fight may not take place anymore.

source: Saag-sõngo, yaa yam-yãkr-sõngo.
target: A good hope is a good decision.

source: Wẽnd na zãag ned ne tags-wẽnse.
target: May God preserve us from evil thoughts.

source: Bala bãmb fãa yĩnsã zabr ya a yembre.
target: Both feel the same pain.

source: Wẽnd na zãag nin-tɩrg ne yel-beedo.
target: May God preserve the just man from misfortune.

source: Sũ-noog wʋsg ka manegd ned ye.
target: Too much joy can be harmful.

source: Ned ka tog n paam saglgo, n yell le rɩ-a ye.
target: He who has received advice should not be carried away by a problem.

source: Rabɛɛm rengda a zabd-n-taag n wudgi.
target: The more fearful is the first to flee from his opponent.

source: Kabr gobr zemsa ne a soabã.
target: "Excuse me for giving you with the left hand" is said to the person to whom one can do it.

source: Kɩɩm geta ned wĩntoogo, n yaool n bugs-a yʋngo.
target: A ghost observes the person he wants to frighten by day before doing it at night.

source: Ned sã n maan a meng bʋʋga, b loet-a-la zaang tẽngre.
target: If someone behaves like a goat, he is tied under an acacia albida faidherbia tree.

source: Zãgs gobr dɩkda tẽnga.
target: If you refuse to receive something that is given to you with your left hand, you will end up taking it from the ground.

source: Wẽnd na laas kɩɩm Gãmbaaga.
target: May God chase away the ghost in Gambaaga.

source: Wẽnd na zãag wagdr ne kõsgo.
target: May God spare the thief from coughing.

source: Kɩɩg ka wʋmd fɩɩl t’a yõor le yũn ye.
target: When the squirrel hears the whistle, blood will not flow from its nostrils.

source: Sosoaag na yɩ neere, bãngda a zomẽ.
target: It is by the quantity of the flour that one can foresee that the collective work will be good.

source: Nimbãan-ned barsda a goamã a bɛɛb taoore.
target: The poor man weighs his words before his enemie.

source: Gũus ne rɩɩb sẽn tõe n pogl-fo.
target: Be careful of any food that can harm you.

source: Ned sã n zoet yell n ka gũusi, a paada yɛlẽ wã.
target: If there is a problem that frightens someone, if they are not careful, they will be drowned in it.

source: Ned fãa tall a sẽn ya-a soaba.
target: Let everyone remain what he is.

source: F sã n tõe n teeg neda, Wẽnnaam teegr n yɩɩda.
target: Even if you can rely on a man, it is still better to rely on God.

source: Ned fãa gũus ne zab tɩ sugr kaẽ wã.
target: Everyone should accept forgiveness and give up fighting.

source: Tags-sõng manegda a soaba.
target: A good thought does good to its author.

source: Ka ned sẽn wʋm fãa la a tog n gom ye.
target: Not everything you hear should be said.

source: Ad yaa võog kipar n lebs yaoobgo.
target: Pull out a chilli tree and replace it with a poisonous tree.

source: Yiis kom n lebs bãase.
target: Remove hunger and replace it with diseases.

source: Fo sã n zãgs Wẽnd na kõ-f sugri, f na n deega Wẽnd na kõ-f laafi.
target: If you refuse to forgive simply, you will receive good wishes for healing.

source: Ned sã n gãnem a neng tɩ b yet t'a yaa nin-wẽnga, t'a to sã n laadẽ tɩ b yet t’a yaa yalma.
target: One man shakes his head and is called a villain, another laughs and is called a fool.

source: Yeel-n-kõn-yã-zĩig yet t’a tõe a noore.
target: If you know that if you say what you know, you will have nowhere to put your head, you have no other solution than to hold your tongue.

source: Ka pãng zabr boondame tɩ yogse.
target: The fight of the powerless is called a game.

source: Ned sã n zomb bõang n serg n kolg a bãngdã, a kolga yiri.
target: If he who rides a donkey stands towards his shoulders; he has come a little closer to the house.

source: Ma yao, ma kẽema, ma meng n yɩɩda.
target: She is my mother's little sister, she is my mother's big sister, she is better than my own mother.

source: Gũus ne goama, tɩ sã n yõsge, manegrã yaa toogo.
target: Be careful what you say, otherwise it will be difficult to repair.

source: Ned sẽn nong bũmb ninga, a na tũ be n ki.
target: Man dies by what he loves.

source: Kũun toga ne reegre.
target: A gift cannot be refused.

source: Yell sã n paam ned bɩ f ra maan sũ-noog tɩ tõe n paama foo me.
target: If a misfortune befalls someone, do not rejoice, for it may befall you too.

source: Rogem yɩɩda zoodo.
target: The bond of kinship is more than friendship.

source: Sẽn paamd-a ka tõe n gil bõn ye.
target: He who comes to have goods cannot but suffer losses.

source: Sãan gũus ne tẽng-n-dãmb goama.
target: Let the foreigner beware of the words of the native.

source: Kẽ tɩ yaa f ma roog beeme, la fuk tɩ yaa f ma rʋk ka ye.
target: You will be told to enter as if it were your mother's hut, but you will never be told to lift the lid of such and such a jar as if it were your mother's jar.

source: Kõt naab beeme, la zãgs naab ka ye.
target: There are master givers, but no master refusers of gifts.

source: Kõat baooda yel-sõmde, tɩ zãgsd baood beem.
target: He who gives does so to attract favour, but he who refuses the gift attracts enmity.

source: Bulg noor ka zon-bi reem zĩig ye.
target: The edge of the well is not a place for blind children to play.

source: Zõang ra a karfo, bɩ gõ-pa-yãndg ning a nugu, tɩ mugnug ning a nugu tɩ yaa b fãa karfo.
target: If a blind man buys a large boubou, let the thorny acacia gourmansis and the jujube trees contribute to it, because the boubou belongs to them all.

source: F sã n yã weef ne gaare, a luba neda.
target: If you meet a horse with a saddle, it is because it has made someone fall.

source: Pondr sã n yi koomẽ n yeel tɩ yẽbg nin n zabde, ned ka tõe n kɩɩs ye.
target: If a toad sounds from the river and tells you that the crocodile has sore eyes, no one can deny that.

source: Yar-zu-kõogo, yaa tẽng-n-ned n togse.
target: It is by a native that one can know the faults of his countryman.

source: Kʋdemd dãmb yeelame tɩ f sã n dɩk zabr tɩɩm n kõ rabɛɛma, f sãama f tɩɩm.
target: The people of long ago say that if you entrust your war potion to a coward, you have spoiled your gris-gris (magic potion).

source: Moaag ne rãam, a na wa.
target: If a Moosi person sees beer, he will certainly come.

source: Ned fãa zãmsda a biig a yel-manesem.
target: Each one teaches his child his way.

source: Ned sã n bãng yell tiiri, a kõn sãmb ye.
target: When one is aware of a problem, one no longer doubts.

source: Naab baooda manegr bala.
target: The ruler seeks only the good.

source: Gũus ne zoe-bõne, tɩ nebã na n wa bãnga f yellã.
target: Try not to be stingy, because if you are, people will know.

source: Ned ning sẽn lʋɩt-a taoor ne wẽng maanegã ka paamd bũmb ye.
target: He who takes the lead to do harm gets nothing.

source: Ned sã n bãng a pag zʋgdo, a bãngda a sẽn na n zã-a to-to.
target: When you know your wife's character, you know how to handle her.

source: Ãbg sã n kʋʋle, a basda a biig ne nao-yẽese.
target: When the panther is old, she passes her claws to her cub.

source: Zõang yeelame tɩ b sẽn yet tɩ miusg ka be raagẽ wã, bɩ a ra wʋm kiõo ye.
target: The blind man says that if he is told that there are no cakes in the market, let him not hear "kioon", i.e. the sound of baking cakes.

source: Silmi-yaalg bãngda a kãndẽ.
target: You can recognise the cheap Fulani person by his spear.

source: Sẽn yõog-a moog ka kʋʋd bũmb ye.
target: He who sets fire to the bush kills nothing.

source: Ned ka bãngd zɩɩb tiiri, tɩ tʋʋsg paoog-a ye.
target: When a man knows that he has to carry a baggage on his head, he looks for a suitable cushion.

source: Naab sã n sonded korgo, talsã sondeda suiibu.
target: If a ruler calls himself "bag", it means that his subjects call themselves "to put in the bag".

source: Pag sã n sonded kãgembɛɛga, a sɩdã tog n sonda m-saas-m-lare.
target: If a woman calls herself "dense thicked", her husband must call himself "I sharpen my axe".

source: Burkĩn ka tog n zoe wɩdg n bas a zaamẽ tʋʋm-sõama ye.
target: A man of integrity should not be afraid of criticism and should not renounce his good deeds.

source: Da rɩk f yell n mak ne ned yell ye.
target: Do not compare your problem with that of others.

source: Kɩɩg zẽed noom yɩɩd walga, yaa koom n ya teg-tege.
target: If it happens that the sauce of squirrel meat tastes better than that of the Ourebi antelope meat, it means that the amount of water used is very small.

source: Bilf-bilf n lebgd wʋsgo.
target: Several small ones together become many.

source: F sã n dat n sagl ned bɩ f ra leng-a ye.
target: When you want to advise someone, do not rebuke him.

source: Ned ka zabd ne sẽn yɩɩd-a ye.
target: You don't fight with someone stronger than you.

source: Ned ka tog n bao yell sẽn yɩɩd a pãng ye.
target: One does not look for a problem that is beyond one's means.

source: Yam a ye n tʋmd tʋʋmde.
target: It is through the union of thoughts that one can act.

source: Ned kõn soos baag t’a yõk bõn-yẽeg ye.
target: No one will encourage his dog to catch a lion.

source: Nebã zãab yaa toogo, bala sẽn gomd ne sẽn ka gomd yell ya toor-toore.
target: Managing people is difficult because a talking being is different from a dumb one.

source: Ned kõn soos baag t'a yõk ãbg ye.
target: No one will encourage his dog to catch a panther.

source: Nin-bãan-ned pʋɩɩr ka ta a taab ye.
target: The share of the unfortunate is less than that of others.

source: Zoe-nif soab rigda nebã ne yam.
target: The respectful man rejects people with wisdom.

source: Yaa soaamb pʋ-gillã yĩng la b soosd baag t’a yõk-a.
target: You can encourage the dog when it is the small-bellied hare.

source: Kũun ka sãamd ned ye.
target: A gift does not damage anyone.

source: Nin-kẽem digbu, yaa f sã n ka na n kẽ bɩ f yi.
target: One way of turning away an elderly man is to say to him: "If you don't want to come in, then get out".

source: Sʋʋr-sʋʋr n pit korgo.
target: By picking up the locusts one by one, one can fill the bag.

source: Ra gõdg m gongo, yaa ra ning-m yãnd ye.
target: "Don't curl me up" means, don't put me to shame.

source: Haya-haya n zẽkd sugri.
target: The roof of a hut can be raised in unison.

source: Kɩɩb miuusgu, a ne yaa wɛdga, a gõe me yaa wɛdga.
target: The orphan's cake: whether he is awake or asleep, he will only receive a piece.

source: Gell mi a sẽn saood n dabdẽ.
target: The egg knows where to dance.

source: Niig koabg ya rasaar a ye, la neb koabg data rasab koabga.
target: One stick is enough to drive a herd of 100 oxen, but it takes 100 sticks to drive 100 people.

source: Lalg fãoob ka sãamd lalg ye.
target: Plastering a wall does not damage it.

source: Ned paamda yell n bãng a zo-rãmba.
target: It is in difficult times that one recognises one's true friends.

source: Gũus-m-meng soab ka menemd ye.
target: The prudent man does not get lost.

source: Naab ba a ya naong soaba, yẽ n so arzek soaba.
target: Even if the chief is poor, he is chief of the rich man.

source: F sã n dat tɩ nebã pẽg-f bɩ f tʋm tʋʋm-sõama.
target: If you want people to praise you, do good deeds.

source: Ned sã n paam paoong bɩ a pʋʋs Wẽnnaam barka.
target: He who has wealth should thank God.

source: Fo sã dat n nebã gomd f yelle, bɩ f tʋm tʋʋm-kɛga.
target: Do bad deeds and you will see that people will often talk about you.

source: Yel-wẽn-maand ka a ka mi ye, ya pʋ-toogo.
target: It is not out of ignorance that the evil one acts, it is on purpose.

source: Ned fãa vɩɩmd tɩ zems a pãnga.
target: Everyone should live within his means.

source: Yɩbr-kʋdr yeela a biig t’a gũus ne rɩɩb sẽn dɩga, tɩ rasaar me rɩga a sɛɛga.
target: An old scavenger / vulture told his cub to beware of food with a stick next to it.

source: Fo sã n dat n kuud n ka roogdẽ, bɩ f ti zãn-pãare.
target: If you want to walk continuously bent over without straightening up, then erect your shed of small height.

source: Fo sã n dat mog-mog bɩ f bʋd f bɩd-bi.
target: If you want good sorrel sauce, grow small sorrel.

source: Bʋʋg sã n paam taam n dɩ, bɩ a pʋʋs sobg barka.
target: If the goat gets shea fruit to eat, let it thank the wind.

source: Tʋʋm-zãgs ka nin n ka ne sorã ye, yaa zʋgdo.
target: He who refuses work is not a blind man who cannot see the way. He has a bad character.

source: Katr nug-zaal n são baag ne guugu.
target: A hyena with empty hands is better than a dog with a club.

source: Fo sã n ka lub n wʋkdẽ, fo ka mi tɩ fo sẽn da tʋkã yaa wʋsg ye.
target: As long as what you carry on your head does not fall off and you have to pick it up, you do not realise that what you carry is in great numbers.

source: Ned ka tog n dig gãnd-gãnd tɩ gũnd-gũnd põs ye.
target: One should not chase what is running fast and let what is running slow escape.

source: F sã n bao a wã-n-yɩɩd n konge, bɩ f bao a wã-n-são.
target: If you look for "this is the greatest" without finding it, look for "this is better".

source: A bao n kong yet tɩ b we n dɩ wã me ne laafɩ.
target: The one who tried unsuccessfully to have said that as long as they eat what they have in good health.

source: Ned fãa sã n dat n maan bũmbu, bɩ a togs neb n paam saglgo.
target: Before doing something, one should share the thought to receive advice.

source: Kãsem sã n gome, yao ka tog n le gom ye.
target: When the elder speaks, the younger brother should not speak anymore.

source: A biigã sẽn ya fo pagã, fo me boondame tɩ f ma.
target: If your wife is his daughter, you call her your mother too.

source: Gomda soog-zãng yelle.
target: This proverb speaks of total possession.

source: Ned ka tog n teeg sõngr bal ye.
target: One should not always expect help from others.

source: Yell fãa pʋg bɩ b mak tɩ manege.
target: In every problematic situation, try to repair.

source: Bɛlgd n tõe sɩd soaba.
target: The flatterer knows how to take the one who tells the truth.

source: Yamb sã n be yir wall weoogẽ, a pʋga a zu-soaba.
target: At home or in the bush, the slave is only following his master.

source: Yam yoob ka be ye, ya a meng tʋʋmde.
target: There is no need to worry, it is her job.

source: Gũus f meng ne ned sẽn sõngd-fo.
target: Beware of the one who helps you.

source: Bõn sã n sut bɩ b kʋrg zʋʋre.
target: If the loss you have is sinking, at least cut off its tail.

source: Yamb ka so a nin me woo, a sẽn yã n dɩkã.
target: The slave is not master of his eyes, let alone what he has found and picked up.

source: Yamb sã n tũ a zu-soab n meneme, ya a zu-soab n meneme.
target: If the slave in the company of his master goes astray, it is the master himself who has gone astray.

source: Pʋg-yãang keema a but wõdb raare.
target: The old woman is strong the day she makes shea butter.

source: Saag ka niid tɩ kamsẽoof leb n ni ye.
target: When it has finished raining, the fig tree does not rain anymore.

source: Pʋʋg kĩnkĩrs ka teeg pʋʋg sag-basdem ye.
target: The spirits of the field do not rely only on the pieces of millet porridge / tô that are thrown to them.

source: Ned ka sõt a sãamb n naag a pag ma ye.
target: One should not count one's mother-in-law as a stranger.

source: Zĩndid m ye kʋʋda baag n moe rɛɛmba.
target: He who chooses to live alone will kill a dog to make a meal for his mother-in-law.

source: Yaa yam ne yam tɩ naab tʋk moodo.
target: The chief can be made to wear grass on his head with cunning.

source: Ned ka ningd a kiba-kɩt yãnd ye.
target: One should not disgrace his accomplice informer.

source: Baag yeelame tɩ yaa yirã soab sãanã n pake, tɩ sã n ya ne yẽ sãanã, bãmb na n zomba taaba.
target: The dog says that he must be careful of his master's visitor, but if it is his visitor, they will jump on each other.

source: Ma rẽgd ka yaand sũur ye.
target: Mommy's dirt does not make you feel nauseous.

source: Ma-rẽgd ka rãmbd sũur ye.
target: Mummy's dirt does not upset the heart.

source: Wẽnd na zãagd ne zab-zabdba.
target: May God keep us from fighting.

source: Goam kẽer yɩɩda talg goama.
target: There are things that a subject is not allowed to talk about.

source: Ned fãa gũus ne zab n ka kõ sugr tɩ fo me tõe n wa beega neda.
target: Everyone should be careful not to quarrel with another without never forgive, for he too may one day offend someone.

source: Ned fãa maan daood tɩ Wẽnnaam ketame.
target: Let everyone take courage, for God is still there.

source: Pʋgẽ yell ya zak pʋgẽ ned n yit n togs nebã.
target: If a family affair is known to outsiders, it is because of a family member.

source: Sũ-to-ned ka bʋdgd mo-be-ned pʋʋgẽ ye.
target: The angry man does not cross the field of the one who has a viper's tongue.

source: Ned fãa meng yell n pak-a.
target: Everyone is preoccupied with their own problems.

source: Roogẽ baag sã n ka rɩk kõbre, yɩng baag ka tõe n paam ye.
target: If the dog inside the house does not take a bone, the dog outside cannot have it.

source: Tẽng-n-ned ne a to ka zɛɛd gãd-m tɩ m wãag ye.
target: It is not uncommon for someone in the village to ask someone else to catch for him so that he can cut.

source: Soaamb yet t'a wʋm a yak põo, la a ra wʋm a meng põo ye.
target: The hare says that he prefers to hear the blow of the stick on his neighbour rather than on himself.

source: Kugr sã n yit yĩngr n watẽ, ned fãa pĩida a zugu.
target: When a stone comes from above, everyone covers his head.

source: Wẽnd waoog ne koaas sẽbre, tɩ zut ne nao ket n dʋrẽ.
target: God forbid that we should see a butcher bound while the head and legs are still lying there.

source: Ned fãa gũus ne beedo.
target: Let everyone beware of greed.

source: Gũus f meng ne goam f sẽn ka wʋmd a võor t'a tõe n dɩ-f lame.
target: Beware of words you don't understand, for it could cost you dearly.

source: Ned fãa maan sẽn kõn yɩ yelle.
target: Let everyone do what will not attract trouble.

source: Tags f tʋʋmdã yell n deng sɛglg tɩ zãra.
target: Think about your work and prepare yourself well before.

source: Ra paoog ned n yaool n kõ-a bũmb t’a na n zãgsame.
target: Do not show contempt to someone before giving him something, because he will refuse it.

source: Ba f sã n mi f meng pʋga, kell n gũus n paase.
target: Even when you know yourself, it is better to be more vigilant.

source: Sẽn tar-a yarn n tʋmd zak tʋʋmd wa a meng tʋʋma.
target: He is the wise one who does the common work of the family as if it were his own work.

source: Zabr be beoog ka tõe n kõ wed-moaag ki ye.
target: It is not on the eve of war that one begins to feed the horse millet.

source: Pʋg-kõor yĩgsa a bãgdẽ, a so-b zãng me ka gõms a bãgd ye.
target: When a widow shrugs her shoulders, he to whom everything belongs does not shake his shoulders.

source: A kogl-kogl ka mi t'a kabr-kabr n a yir n yaool n wa ye.
target: He who moves his dishes does not know that the one who knocks at the door has eaten at his house before coming.

source: Reng n ku la lilg tɩɩm.
target: To hide in advance is the best greywash to make oneself invisible.

source: Yalem kẽ raag tɩ fõt ne burg t’a yaag a noor n tar haa...haa n gilgd raagã.
target: The foolish man came to the market, heard the noise of the voices, opened his mouth, made the sound haa... haa... as he went around the market.

source: Bi-yam soab n daad a ma samsa. Samsa a ma samsa, ligd a ma ligdi.
target: It is a wise child who buys his mother's doughnuts, for the money is his mother's, the doughnuts too.

source: Biig sẽn tar yam ya wa gũuri, n dɩkd n bĩngdẽ.
target: A wise son is like the ant who stores up his food.

source: Ned fãa zomb a sẽn kõn Iʋɩ.
target: Let each one climb on that which he is sure not to fall on.

source: Baas neer n são sɩng neere.
target: It is better to finish well than to start well.

source: Mog tom n tuk zom n são mog zom n tuk tom.
target: To start eating earth and find flour is better than to start with flour than to start with flour and end with dirt.

source: Zoe paoogr gomde.
target: Flee from dishonourable words.

source: Sẽn teeg-a Wẽnd paamda sõngre.
target: He who trusts in God gets help.

source: Pʋg-sõng paoong yaa sɛgbo, Wẽnd kũuni.
target: It is by luck or God's help that one gets a good wife.

source: B ka wɛ n deegd naong soab goam ye.
target: The words of the poor are not often listened to.

source: Pʋg-sad paoong yaa zu-noogo.
target: Marrying a girl is a matter of luck.

source: Ned fãa gũus ne rɩɩb sẽn na n lill sɩda.
target: Everyone should beware of food that makes one hide the truth.

source: Gũus ne taogsg tɩ f tõe n wa lʋɩɩ vɩʋʋgo.
target: Beware of thinking too much, for you may end up in the background.

source: Gũus f meng ne zo-rãmb sẽn ya wẽnsã tũubu.
target: Keep yourself from the company of bad friends.

source: Naab toga ne waoogre.
target: The leader is entitled to respect.

source: Yam soab zak n mete.
target: The wise man succeeds in building his house.

source: Noor ka rɩt n togs beed ye.
target: The mouth that has eaten does not speak evil words.

source: Zɩ n yã noaag n tat n tɩ yunug kʋɩlgẽ.
target: He who has never seen a hen brings his to the pond to water it.

source: Pʋg-sad yaa wa wobg nemdo, sʋʋg sẽn noom-a soab n wãagda.
target: A young girl is like the meat of an elephant; it is he whose knife is sharp who cuts her.

source: Sɩlem dɩg-dɩg yaa sɩlem kẽkdga.
target: Too much cunning ferments.

source: Katr ka teeg bũmb tɩ ka ki-lik ye.
target: The hyena does not tell stories about anything but the moonless night.

source: F sã n dat pag sẽn wẽnd f ma n kẽ kãadem, f na ki ra-kõto.
target: If you want to find a woman like your mother and marry her, you will die single.

source: Naong soab gom-sɩd yaa bugum tar yiri.
target: The poor man's word of wisdom is like a burning hut.

source: Tũud-n-ta-weng sãamda nin-sõngo.
target: The bad companion corrupts the honest man.

source: Ned fãa tog n baoo yam neb a taabã nengẽ.
target: Everyone should learn from the experiences of others.

source: Gũus f meng ne gom-beedã.
target: Beware of saying extravagant words.

source: A bee taogsgã pʋg n yɩɩd yellã pʋgẽ. Dẽ, bɩ f gũus n da zoe rabeem wʋsg ye.
target: Fear is more in the imagination than in the fact. Therefore, beware of panic.

source: Tags wʋsgo, n yaool n leok gomde.
target: Think a lot before giving your opinion on a matter.

source: Ned fãa rata bõn-sõngo.
target: Everyone wants what is good.

source: Ya saglgo, gũus-m-meng yĩnga.
target: Recommendation to be careful.

source: Yãg-yãg wʋsg tõe n sãama yelle.
target: Too much haste spoils business.

source: a) Bãad zãad ka tog n zoe a goamã ye.
target: a) One should not be afraid of the complaints of the sick person under one's care.

source: Ka reng n dog n mi wobg ye, yaa sẽn gõ-a weoog n mi wobgo.
target: It is not the one who was born first who is supposed to know the elephant; it is the one who has done the bush who knows the elephant.

source: Arzɛk soab sã n dat n teel naong rãmb a wɛ, yẽ n na n tõk piig soabã.
target: If a rich man wants to help nine poor people, he will end up being the tenth poor person.

source: Kãoong dabeem n wilgd a gɛl zĩiga.
target: This is the expression of the fear of the guinea fowl that reveals its eggs.

source: Rabeem yaa bãaga.
target: Fear is a disease.

source: Bãad zãad ya a bɛ. b) Fo sã n togs ned sɩda, a kisa foo.
target: The one who takes care of the sick is his enemy. b) If you tell the truth to someone, he hates you.

source: Gomd gomda ne pagdo, tɩ sẽn tar-a yam wegse.
target: One speaks words with shells, and the wise man unpacks them.

source: Bi-sõng yaa buud fãa biiga.
target: The wise child is everyone's child.

source: Velem sã n tar mor me, baag ka zãmsd zams-beed ye. Bilgri .: a) Yell sã n ka f yelle, a ka pak-f ye. b) Zug ka be solgr ye.
target: Even if the Muslim craves meat, the dog does not have a bad dream. b) You cannot hide your character.

source: Ka zoet n bas f ba raboog ya f ba raboog n ka wa.
target: If you say that you will not run away and leave your father's old house, then your father's old house has not come.

source: Ned fãa tog n kõo sugri.
target: Everyone should cultivate forgiveness.

source: Nin-kẽem tagsdame n yaool n maan bũmbu.
target: The old man thinks before taking action.

source: Sugr soab n so bʋʋm.
target: The reason of one who knows how to forgive is the best.

source: Pãng soab n so bũmb fãa.
target: It is the strongest who is master of everything.

source: A wẽnda yalma, la yaool n ka yalem ye.
target: It looks like a fool, but is not.

source: a) Gom wʋsg tɩ f paamda tõogre.
target: a) Speak much and you can be victorious

source: Saglgo, tags-koees rãmbã yĩnga.
target: This one is a tip for the short-sighted.

source: Ka wakat fãa la bag togsd sɩd ye.
target: It is not always that the quack tells the truth.

source: Pãng sã n seg pʋlga, a lebgda rã-yũuga.
target: When strength meets a cereal market, it becomes the customary beer party.

source: Maam ne a zagl ka zĩ maas-yɛng yaa zĩig n ka sobge.
target: "I will not sit in the same shade as so-and-so" is valid until night falls.

source: Bag sã n bʋg-f bɩ f bʋg f menga.
target: If the charlatan tells you what to do, you must also dig your brains out.

source: Ka pẽgd kũun data wagdem.
target: He who is not satisfied with a gift wants to steal.

source: Nin-kẽem sã n zoet bɛng puud pʋʋgẽ, a sã n ka rigd bũmbu, dɩll bũmb n digd-a.
target: When you see an old man running in a bean field, it means that if he is not chasing something, it is himself who is chased.

source: Yʋgempend wẽnda yão-giulgu, la a ka tõe n wẽk wa yão-giulg ye.
target: The hedgehog is like a ball of flour, but he cannot be pressed like a ball of flour.

source: A wẽnda wiuug la a ka kẽed bog-mak ye.
target: It looks like a tapered mouth, but does not fit into a flattened hole.

source: Wẽ-n-yɩlem n kʋʋd waafo. b) Tʋm wʋsg n paamd wʋsgo.
target: b) Travaille beaucoup et tu gagneras beaucoup. The snake is killed by repeated blows. b) Work hard and you will win much.

source: Bõang ka tãood ned t'a tão n lebs ye.
target: The donkey's kick should not be answered with a kick.

source: Ned n togsd a yell n paam saglgo.
target: One must share one's problem before getting advice.

source: Biig sẽn tar yam sõngda a ba.
target: The wise child helps his father.

source: Yam goam tara yõod la a ka paamd daar a yembr ye, yaa bilf-bilfu.
target: The words of the wise man are useful, but are not obtained in one day, it is a little at a time.

source: a) Koob ka kʋʋd ned ye, maan n zems f pãnga.
target: a) Cultivating does not kill, but works to the limit of your strength.

source: Sɩd goam sõngda neda.
target: Words of truth are useful.

source: Gom-wẽng ka be nin-tɩrg noorẽ ye.
target: Bad words do not come out of the mouth of the righteous.

source: Yel-wẽn-maand sã n ka zoet nebã me, bɩ a zoe Wẽnde.
target: If the perverse man is not afraid of men, let him at least fear God.

source: Bãg-vɩɩd soab sã n ka zoet waood me, bɩ a zoe Wẽnnaam.
target: Even if the man who wears a sleeveless garment is not afraid of the cold, let him fear God.

source: Koob sã n noomẽ me, roog tɩ d kuil n yɩɩda. b) Zab sã n noomẽ me, laad n yɩɩda.
target: Even if cultivating is pleasant, ceasing and returning home is even more pleasant. b) If fights are interesting, laughter is more interesting.

source: Koom na sa m nifẽ pondr yaa pond-koɛɛnga.
target: The toad who wants to witness the end of the river water will be a dry toad.

source: Bũmb ka be liuul noorẽ tɩ ka sib-paok ye.
target: There is nothing in the beak of a bird but the skin of grapes.

source: Goabg sã n zãad kãnde, yaa rɩtg la a sõngda.
target: If the left hand holds a spear, it is to help the right hand.

source: Ned n wẽed no-bɩng tɩ bugum yõka a roogo, tɩ nebã yaool n wa ne koom.
target: The people bring water to the cries of alarm of one whose hut is on fire.

source: Ned n koosd a bãaga, n yaool n paam a tɩɩm.
target: One sells one's illness to obtain a cure.

source: No-ger kẽeda pʋgẽ, la yĩida bilf-bilfu.
target: The chicken leg reaches the stomach, but is eaten little by little.

source: Rũmd põdame n zems rõabga.
target: The knee is made bending so that one can squat.

source: Keeg-wok ka lebd weoogẽ ye.
target: He who cuts too long does not return to the bush.

source: Sẽn tʋmd-a wʋsg n são kʋɩɩma.
target: He who works a lot is better than a lazy person.

source: Rɩɩb ka noom me, a yiisda kom.
target: Even if the food doesn't taste good, it relieves hunger.

source: Yaa neb sẽn na n yã taab la b tõe n maneg yelle.
target: It is when we meet that we can solve problems.

source: Sã n paooge, yaa tɩlɛ tɩ f peng n paase.
target: If you don't have enough money, you are obliged to pay for it.

source: Sũ-noog yaa zu-noog tɩɩm.
target: Joy is a remedy for good luck.

source: Tʋmd f tʋʋm tao-tao tɩ wakat loogdame.
target: Accomplish your task promptly as time passes.

source: Rɩ-noang sũ-noog yaa tɩgr daare.
target: He who loves to eat rejoices on the day of the feast.

source: Zu-noog soab sã n paam yell fãa, a tõogdame n manege.
target: Whenever a lucky person has a problem, he manages to solve it.

source: Yɛl wʋsgo, rɩllame tɩ b maan sugri, key rẽ a manegr yaa toogo.
target: For many problems, one needs indulgence to solve problems.

source: Tʋʋm-bɛnl n tõe tʋʋmde.
target: It is working a lot that ends up working

source: Gomd yaa wa sugr moogo, sã n foog-a, lebs n tui yaa toogo.
target: Speech is like a piece of straw from the roof. Once it is removed, it becomes difficult to put it back.

source: .Daar-daar ya yʋʋmde.
target: Put off until tomorrow and it is next year.

source: Zu-noog soab kuirg wĩir kaoogda bãgend tẽngre.
target: The lucky man's belt breaks near a rope plant.

source: Ned ka rɩt n bas a ãnd n zĩ ye.
target: One does not eat without the one who has been asked "who is sitting there?

source: Pondr bob n da kell yaa dindibd yɩgb raare.
target: The day the toad takes all that belongs to him is the day the termites fly away.

source: Laafɩ tɩɩm ka raad n kell ligd ye.
target: One does not spare his money when paying for health.

source: Talg velem yita arzɛk soab maand daare.
target: The desire to eat the meat of the poor ends on the day the rich person makes his sacrifices.

source: Pĩir ka neer me, a ka tõt gõeem ye.
target: Even if the mat is not beautiful, it does not prevent you from sleeping on it.

source: Ned yell sã n dat n sãame, a ka kelgd saoglg ye.
target: When problems are going to take someone away, he does not listen to advice.

source: Fo sã n Iʋɩ f bɛ nugẽ, tɩɩm ka ye.
target: If you fall into the hands of the enemy, there is no salvation.

source: Mak ned n ges a sã n tõeeme.
target: A person is tested to find out his abilities.

source: Ned sẽn nong a soab ka zʋg ye.
target: He whom one loves has no bad character.

source: Ned tõeeme n b zoe-a, la a ka tõe tɩ b nong-a ye.
target: Someone can make you fear him, but cannot make you love him.

source: Ned sã n tʋmd n ka nafdẽ, a sã n ka tʋmdẽ n yɩɩda.
target: If someone works without earning much, what will he earn if he does not work?

source: Wẽnaam kũun yɩɩda baoobo.
target: The gift of God is better than what one has obtained oneself.

source: Tʋʋm-sõamã ne tʋʋm-beedã fãa yaa ninsaal n maande.
target: Good or bad deeds are done by man.

source: Bũmb sã n ya a yiibu, a ye n yɩɩda.
target: If there are two things, one is more than the other.

source: Tu long n bãng zõanga.
target: Dig a hole and you will know who is blind and who is not.

source: F sã n tũ naab n tɩ paam kamaana, bɩ f le kẽng f yembr tɩ b bãng tɩ yaa naab yĩnga.
target: If you were in the company of the chief and you get fresh corn, go back on your own so that we know it was because of the chief.

source: Kĩnkirs roog sã n dat wãabo, b sõsda kɩparen-tɩɩsẽ.
target: If the house of the bush spirits is being dispersed, they meet near the chilli bushes to talk.

source: Maand-m-menga, ka Wẽnd n sokd ned ye.
target: When someone is responsible for his misfortunes, he has no god who will question for him.

source: Kur sã n ki tãng zugu, tãntãnoos paama gẽbse.
target: When a turtle dies on a mountain, the wild chickens got seeders.

source: Gũun-daoog sã n ki yokẽ, bõn-pogs paama kagse (nug-bĩnsi).
target: When a millipede dies in the hollow of a tree, the lizards have obtained rings.

source: Zu-noog ne zu-beed fãa yaa zug a yembre.
target: Good luck or bad luck reaches the same person.

source: Pʋg-zẽeg sã n tok-f noogo, nasaara n kõogd f yiri.
target: If you take a liking to light-skinned women, a white man will lay the foundation of your house.

source: Sag-võ-bɛd sã n budum biiga, kom gãag n nobd-a.
target: If abundant meals make a child spinal, it is hunger that will make him fat

source: Pag sẽn gʋʋnd bũmb ningã n são a pʋg-to beeme bɩ ?
target: What a woman raises is better than the question "Is her co-wife there?

source: Naam sã n ka be, nebã fãa yaa yembre.
target: Without the quality of a leader, all men are the same.

source: F sã n dell pãng soab bɩ f bas rabeem.
target: If you have a strong man as your protector, stop being afraid.

source: Buud sã n ta naab taoore, naab sẽn yeelã la sɩda.
target: If the dispute reaches the chief, it is only what he says that is true.

source: Gũus ne zĩrẽ-be-ned saglgo.
target: Beware of the liar's advice.

source: Ra zãag ne f yel-sõmd soab ye.
target: Do not go away from your benefactor.

source: Ned sũur sẽn noom ne bũmb ning ka sekd-a ye.
target: What one likes is not enough for him.

source: Ned fãa bãng a meng t’a ka tõe n bãng a to ye.
target: Let each one know himself, for he cannot know others.

source: Sɩd ne zĩrẽ ka tõe n naag taab ye.
target: Truth and lie cannot go together.

source: Sãbs yũug n da baaga, ket n yaa rõabga.
target: To criticize your cat and buy a dog is to forget that he too sits on his forelegs.

source: Pakr sã n tar ned t’a tɩ rʋʋd tãng zugu, yaa tɩ paas pakre.
target: If someone is plagued by a problem and he climbs the mountain, he increases his problem.

source: Tãoong n belg mood n b boond-a tɩ saaga, ka rẽ, yẽ me ya moodo.
target: It is because of the rope that a certain grass is called broom, otherwise it too is grass.

source: Waaf sa n ka zugu, a yaa rasaare.
target: A snake without a head is like a stick.

source: Beor-pɛɛb sã n fʋʋs nif n konge, ralla saag sobgo.
target: If a horn blower fails to get out what is in your eye, you have only to wait for the storm.

source: Zĩrẽ zãn-daoog ka palgd sɩd zãnd ye.
target: One does not place a pole of lies on the shed of truth.

source: Zirẽ-be-ned sã n kʋ waaf bɩ f ra gãndg ye.
target: When the liar kills a snake, do not step over it.

source: Zĩrẽ-be-ned kĩin ka kẽed zãng ye.
target: The liar's guinea fowl do not enter the henhouse.

source: Waoong zu-zekr ya a sẽn na n yi kʋʋr n wate tɩ b le yeel t'a pʋgdb n ki
target: The glory of the mask is to hear that his aunt is dead, when he returns from the funeral.

source: Ned ne a sɩlem fãa, sẽn na n yõk-a koomã yam yɩɩd-f lame.
target: No matter how cunning you are, the one who has to catch you is more cunning than you.

source: Ka tõe n maan ka pʋ-toog ye.
target: It is not on purpose that one is incapable.

source: Gũus-m-meng soab ka maand tɩ yõsg ye.
target: The prudent person does not exaggerate anything.

source: Zoe-bõn goama.
target: Words showing greed.

source: Zĩrẽ goam yĩmda sɩda.
target: Lying words forget the truth.

source: Bas goamã la f maan sõngr tʋʋmde.
target: Stop talking and do what will help others.

source: Su-noog wakat tagsg yaa sõama.
target: Thoughts in a time of joy are good.

source: Ned fãa ne a pãng wala a naam, kũum tõe-a lame.
target: Whether one is a leader or a man of authority, death prevails.

source: Wẽnd na zẽk m dɛɛmb naoore, ko-a weefo !
target: "May God make my father-in-law travel well. If this is your wish, give him a horse.

source: Pʋg-yãang yet tɩ m yẽn bee yɛ tɩ m zuud bĩis-gɛla.
target: Such an old woman says, "Where are my teeth so that I can steal curd?

source: Pʋg-yãang n yet tɩ : «m zom bʋg tɩ m baood bug-sãan-bedre.
target: Such an old woman says, "What is my flour worth so that I look for a big ember?

source: Gõeem na yɩ noog bãngda suusg wakate.
target: By the manner of dozing one may deduce that sleep will be pleasant.

source: Ned ka ningd a ka-wãbdem kug ye.
target: No one throws pebbles into the millet he is munching.

source: Bũmb ninga sẽn ka yõod n tũud a ma t'a nao wɩsge.
target: It is the worthless one who follows his mother to stretch his legs.

source: Nif sã n keem me, gõeem tõe-a lame.
target: Even if the eye is well, sleep can tame it.

source: b) Mo-pa-tẽedg n leokd nifu.
target: 280. a) Sũmd pʋgẽ bilã n kʋʋd-a. a) It is the germ in the grain that kills it b) It is the unexpected straw that touches the eye.

source: Kom wakate, b ka baood yamleoog rɩɩb ye.
target: In times of famine, you don’t only eat what you like

source: Ned ninga sẽn gomd-a kõta neb wʋsg yam.
target: The man who talks a lot opens the minds of many people.

source: Yell sã n pak neda, a ka soa a meng ye.
target: The one who is in trouble does not control himself anymore.

source: Ned sũur sẽn nong bũmb ningã la a bõn-sõngo.
target: This thing you like is the best.

source: Yam ka tõe n paoog neb a yiib ye.
target: Two individuals cannot lack ideas.

source: Pʋlem-noog noogda sũuri.
target: A good promise makes the heart happy.

source: Yell sa n wat foo, a rãamdã wẽeda fo sũurã.
target: When a misfortune comes upon you, you have premonitions.

source: Yell sã n ka maane, ned ka rɩkd yam ye.
target: If one has not suffered damage, one does not learn lessons.

source: Gom-to-ned bidgda a bʋʋm.
target: If you want to talk too much, you lose your innocence.

source: Noaag ka lobd t'a geef zɩ tiir ye.
target: A hen does not lay eggs without her crest knowing.

source: Korg bob n pɩʋʋg bãok sɩngda peendã wʋgbẽ.
target: The bag that can be carried on the shoulder is so designed from the weaving of its fabric.

source: Nong m pagã yaa nong m dɛɛmba.
target: To love your wife is to love your father-in-law.

source: Noos roog ka manegd tɩ noos ket zãng ye.
target: One does not remake one's hen house when the number of hens is still intact.

source: Yʋng ka fɩɩndã yaa bugum n ka yõk yiri.
target: The expression 'You don't whistle at night' holds good as long as the fire does not ignite a hut.

source: Bʋ-yãbdg n kõt bʋ-sĩndg koom.
target: The bleating goat feeds the silent goat.

source: Be bʋʋm ka yɛs na-yir ye.
target: The one who wins a case at the chief's house should not linger there.

source: Neb a yiib ka baood yok raoog n kong ye.
target: When two people each cut a pole in a hollow, there is no failure.

source: Ned yam tɩɩg la a tãpo.
target: It is from a branch of the tree of choice that one makes his bow.

source: Gell ka tɩ b sẽed noaba.
target: For lack of eggs, one toasts a nut.

source: Pʋ-to-ned ka tõe n maneg la a tõe n sãamame.
target: The wicked man can't fix anything, but he can spoil everything.

source: Ned sã n dat foo ne wẽnga, a tõeeme.
target: If someone wants to hurt you, he can.

source: Yam-yãkr n so ninsaala.
target: The man is guided by his will.

source: Deng n maneg f meng yell n yaool n maneg f taab yɛla.
target: Take care of your own affairs first before you take care of others'.

source: Ned sã n ka gome, a ka maand bũmb ye.
target: As long as no one talks to him, he does nothing.

source: Sũ-noog ka paamd tɩ bũmb ka maan ye.
target: One does not get joy without action.

source: B sã n dat n sãam neda, b rõt-a lame zĩrẽ.
target: When you are angry with someone, you accuse him falsely.

source: Bark pʋʋsgo, kũun-lingdim yĩnga.
target: To thank for a surprise gift.

source: Pag sak tɩ tɩɩm sake.
target: For the gris-gris (magic product) to work, the woman must consent.

source: Ãnda n dɩk kaam n zɛ bõanga ?
target: Who took his cream to apply to the donkey?

source: Silmi-wãoor yet t'a ka tõe n pẽ bĩisim la a tõe n tus n daagame.
target: Such a Fulani leper says that he cannot milk the cow, but he can make the milk spill.

source: B sã n dat yũug n kʋ, b baooda no-kõbd n be a noorã.
target: When you want to kill a cat, you apply feathers to its mouth.

source: Koom zoeta bɛgd zugu.
target: Water flows over mud.

source: Gũun-daoog yeelame tɩ b sã n dat n kʋ-a lame, bɩ b kʋ-a la b bas a ma wõda kaam zaamẽ.
target: The centipede said that you can kill it if you are angry with it, but stop saying that its mother made butter yesterday.

source: Koom ka longd n dɩ zom ye.
target: One does not eat flour soaked over water.

source: Reng n yãk f kɩgbr gõaag n yaool n yãk f naoorẽ gõaaga.
target: First remove the thorn on your buttock before you remove the one on your foot.

source: Ne y kẽnd sãoo ne y zĩiga.
target: It is better to walk than to sit.

source: A beeg-n-mi-tiir yet tɩ tẽngã na n wãame.
target: he who knows that he has offended someone says that things will get hot in the village.

source: Sõngr ka zãgsd ye.
target: One should not refuse help.

source: Talg sa n sɛg naaba, yẽesem saame.
target: When the subject meets the chief on his way, he loses his pride.

source: Yãnd n be n mat neb wʋsgo.
target: There are shames that affect many people.

source: Sãan tõe n dɩɩ rɩɩb la a ka tõe n leo goam ye.
target: A visitor can eat, but cannot answer when others speak.

source: Yell ka be n são yel-bil n be.
target: It is better to have no problem at all than a small problem.

source: Zĩrẽ sã n deng taoore sɩdã togsg lebga toogo.
target: Where the lie has gone before, it is difficult to tell the truth.

source: Arzɛk soab ne naong soab ka tõe n sõs ne taab ye.
target: A rich man and a poor man cannot talk together.

source: Pãng soab n so bũmb fãa.
target: The strong man dominates over everything.

source: Ned sã n beege, a gũusda goama.
target: He who is wrong is careful what he says.

source: Kʋɩlg bas-m-yam la koɛɛnga.
target: One crosses a river without fear, when one knows that it is dry.

source: M bɛ reng-m naabẽ tɩ padeng lebg toogo.
target: My opponent has beaten me to the chief, and it is now difficult for me to retract my statement.

source: Sãan yaagda wɛgda, a ka yaagd goamã ye.
target: The visitor takes out what he finds in the sauce to eat, but does not take out any words.

source: Sãan ka mi long ye. Sãan ka mi tẽng yell ye.
target: The stranger does not know that there is a hollow.

source: A Pʋg-n-wuk ne a kom-n-tar-m ka tõe n sõs ne taab ye.
target: The bloated and the hungry cannot talk together.

source: Zĩig sã n sobge, muk pʋ-yagb saame.
target: The lie of the mute ends with nightfall.

source: Kom zoeta tɩgre.
target: Hunger is afraid of abundance.

source: Wa tɩ m deeg f wãk ka maood n kao ki ye.
target: "Let me take your hoe' is not a subject to struggle to break the feet of millet.

source: Yikaar yãnd yaa niig fãa yande.
target: the shame inflicted on the bull is the shame of all oxen.

source: Tẽeg f taab yell lokre.
target: When you have a business to settle, share with your pairs.

source: Mi-m-neng sãoo paoongo.
target: To be bold is better than wealth.

source: Ka nand kũun baasda zaalem.
target: He who does not consider a gift ends up empty-handed.

source: Yam soab sãoo pãng soaba.
target: A wise man is better than a powerful man.

source: Yam soab n são pãng soaba.
target: A wise man is better than a strong man.

source: Tʋʋm-sõama la tʋʋm-wẽns fãa yaa ninsaal n maanda.
target: Good deeds and bad deeds are all done by man.

source: Ned ka be n yɩɩd belgr ye.
target: No one is safe from deception.

source: Ned ne a yam fãa, a tõe daa no-wabga.
target: No matter how cunning the man is, he can buy a lame hen.

source: Kʋɩlg yẽgb sãoo tãng yɛgbo.
target: It is better to go along a river than a mountain.

source: Saam-y ne wõd-y fãa yaa nug-raoog a ye.
target: To mix or knead is to raise the thumb.

source: So-soakd ka menemd ye.
target: He who inquires about the way forward does not get lost.

source: Rat wʋsg kongda zãnga.
target: By wanting to gain too much one loses everything.

source: Ka pẽgd kũun data wagdem.
target: He who is not satisfied with the gift given to him prefers to steal.

source: Bugvãr yeelame tɩ yẽ bee bokã pʋg a yembre, la tɩɩgã tẽngre, b ya wʋsgo.
target: The cricket says he is alone in the hole, but he is not alone under the tree, there are many.

source: Soaamb yeelame tɩ b bao yɩleng la b vẽ yakemde.
target: The hare said to seek multiplication rather than volume.

source: Kukur kaoogr zemsa ka-koaad yaamse.
target: The breaking of the hoe handle coincides with the farmer's fatigue.

source: Gũus tɩ ned tõe n belg-f lame n tudgi.
target: Beware, for you can be deceived by trickery.

source: Naong soab gom tɩ f ka reeg t’a le gomda.
target: The poor man talks, you don't listen to him and he talks again.

source: Ned ra wʋm gomd n deng n gom ye. A soab sã n yeel t’a pa yeele, fo lebga zĩrẽ-be-neda.
target: Beware of saying that so-and-so said this or that. If he denies, you become a liar.

source: Ned da yĩm a ba yir yell ye.
target: No one should forget his country.

source: Ned sã n ka nong foo me, fo we n bao nonglem ne yẽnda.
target: Even if someone else does not like you, you should try to make friends with him.

source: F sã n vɩ n ka tar zoa, fo sã n wa tar yelle, f ka le tõe n paam zoa ye.
target: If you live without having a friend, when you have a problem, you cannot have a friend.

source: Pãng sã n sa bɩ f boog f sɩdã togsgo.
target: If your strength ends, stop telling the truth.

source: Zirẽ-be-ned ka mi tɩ kɛlgd tara yam ye.
target: The liar does not know that the listener is intelligent.

source: Yell sã n yɩɩd f pãng n paam-fo, yaa f zĩ n getẽ bala.
target: If a problem beyond your strength falls on you, you can do nothing but sit and watch.

source: Yell sã n ya vẽenega, ka le baood bilgr ye, wala kaset dãmb ye.
target: When something is clear, there is no need for explanation or witnesses.

source: Goeoog kaoogr zemsa ne mo-wʋrd yaamse.
target: The breaking of the handle of the sickle coincides with the fatigue of the reaper.

source: Sũ-toog tar noaag kõn vam a noore.
target: A hen may be bitter, but she cannot bite her lip.

source: Zõang mugna, pãb n ka wʋk n le pãbda.
target: The blind man's jujubes: he taps the tree, does not finish picking up what has fallen and taps again.

source: F sã n gũs n ka yã ned t’a nek-fo, fo sã n ki f ka na n yã ned t’a lebg-f ye.
target: If you have no one to wake you up from your sleep, it means that if you die, there will be no one to make you change your position.

source: Maasem sã n ka tat walga, bɩ walg serg n bao maasem.
target: If the shadow does not reach the antelope, the antelope must go to the shadow.

source: Gãoobg n yet tɩ ned sã n deem n tão, bɩ f reem n yɩke.
target: The raven says that if someone amuses himself by throwing a stone at you, amuse yourself by flying away

source: Kʋk zũnzũr ka mi tɩ tɩ-sãbsg le beeme ye.
target: The caterpillar of the cauldron does not know that there is another sweet-tasting tree.

source: Ba yir lobda ne tãn-dagre, ka lobgd ne kugr ye.
target: One does not throw a stone against one's homeland, but a clod of earth.

source: Ned ra reng wʋʋg n lʋɩ koomẽ ye.
target: One should not precede the Nil monitor in the water.

source: Waaf kõn dɩg n b le makd ne kãnkãr ye.
target: When the snake is laid before him, it is no longer necessary to estimate its length on a rod.

source: Ned fãa gãd a sẽn tar kãnkãe.
target: Let everyone hold on tightly to what he has.

source: Bõn-sõng ka ye, yaa zãab-sõng n be.
target: There is no such thing as a good thing in itself. It is when you maintain it well that it is good.

source: Toog ka tõe n solg ye.
target: One cannot hide one's pain.

source: Duni tara yidim-yidim tɩ ned sã n kɩɩse, a na n yãame.
target: In this world there are hierarchies and if someone disputes this, he will learn it the hard way.

source: Ned sã n ka zoet yelle, a rella neda.
target: He who is not afraid of problems relies on someone.

source: Kʋʋng goam yaa kɩɩs-taaba, n yaool n ya gomd a ye bala.
target: When discussing in a group, there are various arguments, but all around one subject.

source: Zĩrẽ sã n wa sokdẽ, rẽ n zĩrẽ-be-ned n zĩ.
target: If someone is being questioned about a lie he has told, there is a liar nearby.

source: Yell sã n paam-y bɩ y maneg-a la y bas taab rõdbo.
target: If you have a common problem, try to solve it instead of blaming each other.

source: Lamd peoog ka zɩs yaa tẽng n pẽ.
target: "A cotton basket is not heavy", this is true as long as the village is not far away.

source: Kãar sã n be gũuda, bɩ noor gom a yam.
target: When the neck is protected, the mouth says what it wants.

source: Zĩrẽ bok sã n tuuda, rẽ tɩ zĩrẽ baag n dõbe.
target: When one is digging the hole of lies, there is a lying dog lying in wait.

source: Tẽn-noog ka ye, bãng n zĩnd n be.
target: There is no village to live in, you just have to know how to live there.

source: Dogem daar ka be yãnd ye.
target: On the day of childbirth, the woman knows no more shame.

source: Koaas ne a to yaa ra wãag be ye, yaool n yaa be bal la yẽ me na n wãage.
target: A butcher will say to another, 'don't cut there', when it is only there that he too will cut.

source: Ned sã n bas a rɩɩgẽ yaoore, a na gũ tãmbeoko.
target: He who abandons his large termite mound of last year where he picked winged termites, will find himself with a small termite mound whose termites are meant for chicks.

source: Saag sã n nag-y bɩ y ra le nag taab ye.
target: If the rain beats you, don't fight any more.

source: Kãnkãr kõn dɩk a meng n mak ne raoog tɩ saag n sek-a ye.
target: One should not compare a millet stalk to a wood because it has received enough rain.

source: Tʋʋm-kɛg soab gũusda wɩdse.
target: The man who knows he is at fault tries to find out who is criticizing him.

source: Ra maan pu-toog tʋʋmd ye.
target: Do not do evil deeds.

source: Bũmb fãa manegr tara a soaba.
target: Every problem has one who can solve it.

source: Zoe-bõn ka be ne yell sẽn tog n maneg ye.
target: When a problem must absolutely be solved, there is no need to be stingy.

source: Nebã nonga nin-sõng n yɩɩd nin-wẽnga.
target: Men prefer the good one to the bad one.

source: Naam sẽn be zĩig ninga, tudgr ka be yɛs ye.
target: Where authority prevails, there are no more false steps.

source: Ra yãg ne yell ning sẽn wat ye.
target: One should not be in a hurry about what will surely happen.

source: Zĩrẽ tõe n solga yʋʋm wʋsgo, la a na n wa pukame.
target: The lie may hide for many years, but it will eventually come to light.

source: Biig reemda a sẽn ka yabẽ zaamẽ.
target: The child returns to enjoy himself where he did not cry yesterday.

source: Ned kẽngda a na kõ-m noaag yiri, a ka kẽngd a noos waoog yir ye.
target: One goes to the one who is sure to give him a chicken, not to the one who has many chickens.

source: Zĩrẽ zoeta yʋʋm koabga, tɩ sɩd yõk-a raar a yembre.
target: The lie flees for a hundred years but the truth catches it in one day.

source: Yɩɩg get n baood a zondo.
target: He who seeks to see very far is in danger of being blind.

source: Yel-pʋg n yiisd rũn-pʋga.
target: It is a big problem that sells an animal in gestation.

source: A ka tɩgd yãamd na tɩg n gele.
target: He who is never satisfied with the potion will eventually falter from excess.

source: Goam ka set a mi goam taoor ye.
target: One could never end a discussion before one who knows how to speak.

source: Saag ka ni la goam be pʋʋgẽ beoogo.
target: It has not rained, but there will be discussions in the field tomorrow.

source: Pãng sã n tũud sore, sɩd bʋta moogo.
target: When force follows a path, the truth also follows this path.

source: F sã n ka so goam bɩ f maan gũusgu.
target: If the discussion is not yours, beware.

source: Biig sã n lebg bedre, ka le tõe n sagl ye.
target: Once a child grows up, one can no longer give him advice.

source: Yaa ned sẽn maan yell n ka rat tɩ b gom n pademda.
target: It is when someone has done something bad and does not want to be talked about that he says this.

source: Bũmb kẽer maaneg ya toog tɩ yaool n ya tɩlɛ tɩ maane.
target: There are difficult acts to do, but they are unavoidable.

source: Yɩɩd taab bee zĩig fãa.
target: There is a hierarchy everywhere.

source: Wakat n be n tog ne sõs-n-kaoos tɩ wakat me be tɩ ka tog n sõs n kaoos ye.
target: There are times when one must talk for a long time, but there are also times when one times when one should not talk for a long time.

source: F sã n mi yell la f kɩɩse, a rɩt-f lame.
target: If you know something and disobey, you bear the consequences.

source: Sɩd sã n Wa bɩ b togs la b bas zoe-nifu.
target: When the time comes to speak the truth, do so without fear of offending.

source: Walg sã n ki weoogẽ, a zɩt mii tiiri.
target: When an Ourebi antelope dies in the bush, the one who has to carry him knows it in advance.

source: Ra-koɛɛng ka gõt ye.
target: . One cannot bend dry wood.

source: Ned sã n da bɩ f lemb-a.
target: If someone buys, add to it.

source: Sõs n kaoos wata ne korg wẽbsgo.
target: When you talk for a long time, you end up feeling the contents of the bags.

source: Yell sã n ya sɩda, zug gõmsda a toore. Pʋ-peelem soab goam yaa tɩrse.
target: When a word is true, the head goes up by itself.

source: Gend-gend wɛsla, wãb tɩ f ba ki, la bas tɩ f ma ki.
target: A couscous dilemma: if you eat it, your mother dies; if you do not eat it, your mother dies.

source: Zoe nif ka be ne wãoor ra tʋm m dɩɩbẽ ye.
target: You should not be courteous to a leper who wants to put his hand in your food.

source: Togs sɩd nukda noor la a ka feoogd yẽnd ye.
target: Telling the truth may make one sulk, but do not pull out a tooth.

source: Ka so miusg yõngda kɩrenga.
target: When the wafer is not yours, you take a little piece.

source: Maam n yõnge, la m beeme.
target: I took a piece and put it back.

source: Sẽn tar sõangd gomda a sẽn data.
target: He who has supporters says what he wants.

source: Yaa saglg la belsgo, ne ned yell sẽn pake.
target: Advice and consolation to the one who is going through trials.

source: a) Ned sẽn dat tɩ b sagl-a, la b ra gom tɩ ned wʋm ye.
target: a) Someone who wants to be advised and does not want anyone to hear what is said.

source: Zu-bedr n paad ne a soaba, ka rẽ, yel-bedr ka paad ne a soab ye.
target: He who has a big head cannot get rid of it, but someone who has a serious problem can find the solution.

source: Buk-ma, la f ra sɩɩs-ma. b) Ned sẽn dat tɩ b sõng-a la b ra sagl-a ye.
target: Put me on my back, but do not touch me. b) Someone who wants help without giving advice.

source: Be neb warb n yãt kilsgu.
target: He who has supporters gets cheered when he dances.

source: Pondr pʋɩɩr ka rʋʋd tɩɩg ye.
target: The part reserved for the toad is not put on a tree.
